reviews.text:
The bad reviews are true. I’ve read reviews about this app having terrible AI, unnecessarily long wait times for a response, and a very expensive and intrusive subscription that pops up almost each time you try sending a chat to any of the characters. 

I’ve also experienced my chats completely disappearing as I tapped the back arrow just to go back on it to see their response. I didn’t get any response, instead, I had my chat completely deleted automatically as I went to the chat section. 


There are not many characters and the 40$ price for the subscription per-month is ridiculous. I don’t recommend this app to anyone. 



If you want one of the best AI girlfriend experiences, go to the website ourdream.ai for a true 18+ experience. It does require a subscription of a price of just 10$ or a little more. This isn’t sponsored or promoted. It’s just a suggestion and a recommendation. It is worth the money. Please keep in mind that this website doesn’t respond to refund requests nor provide refunds despite having the option to.

Forget pictures. I’ve asked 6 different models for 6 different photos… all listed under the model under Photos… no matter WHO it is, or WHAT is asked for, I get the exact same picture… and none of them are the model, and none of them are doing what the prompt says. If they only had 2nphotos, the app would be twice as good. This is just garbage
